candidates.change_summary: Delete the entire body of withdrawAll so that it does nothing, leaving withdrawAll unchanged while the original would have changed it (by transferring balance).
Replace the argument to withdraw with 0 so no balance is transferred, causing withdrawAll to remain unchanged.
Remove the require check from onlyOwner so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Remove the require statement so onlyOwner becomes a no-op, allowing anyone to call withdraw.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw(uint256) so anyone can withdraw funds.
Delete the transfer statement inside withdraw(uint256), so no ether is ever sent.
Remove the msg.sender == owner check so anyone can call functions with the onlyOwner modifier.
Delete the modifier body so onlyOwner performs no access control.

Replace the low-level call with a regular transfer, which forwards a fixed 2300 gas and reverts on failure, changing the observable success/failure behavior for recipients with fallback logic requiring more gas or returning data.
Send the value to msg.sender instead of _target, so the call sends ether to the owner rather than the intended recipient.
Change the call to send 0 value, so the recipient receives no ether.
Delete the sendMoney body entirely, so it does nothing and does not transfer ether.
Replace the revert-on-failure with no action, so a failed call silently succeeds with no ether transfer.
